## Added

- `/sharedgroup enable health` and `/sharedgroup disable health` turn health synchronization on or off. The setting is saved in `configuration.yml` and can only be changed outside a game.

## Changed

- Damage handling has been rebuilt. Minecraft now applies damage itself, so armor, enchantments, absorption, knockback and hurt animations behave exactly like vanilla. The plugin then shares the health each player actually lost with the rest of the group.
- A lethal hit is now handled before the player dies: a totem held by the player or found in any group member's inventory saves the whole group, otherwise the whole group dies.
- Deaths that bypass totems, such as the void or `/kill`, now kill the whole group too.

## Fixed

- Standing in cactus, lava or fire no longer drains the group's health almost instantly: invulnerability frames work again.
- Health regeneration no longer cancels damage taken during the same tick.
